info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Product Inventory Item Update API
info.description: The Product Inventory Item Update API facilitates the modification of existing product inventory items within a banking context. This endpoint allows users to adjust attributes such as pricing, availability, and specifications based on current market conditions or operational needs. Typical consumers of this API include inventory managers and financial analysts who require real-time updates to inventory data for accurate reporting and decision-making. By utilizing this API, businesses can enhance their inventory accuracy and responsiveness to market changes.

patch.description: This operation allows you to update the details of a specific product inventory item identified by its unique identifier. Ensure that you provide the necessary data in the request body to apply the changes.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the product inventory item with the identifier PROD-700045. It requires the necessary fields to reflect the changes in inventory, such as stock levels, pricing, or other relevant inventory attributes. Please ensure all required fields are included in the request.
